newsitem.title: USA: Schnitzer has 2.8 mln Proler shares.
newsitem.headline: Schnitzer has 2.8 mln Proler shares.

text.p: Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc said on Friday that 2.8 million shares of Proler International Corp has been tendered to it as of the close of business yesterday, and it has extended its tender offer to 1700 EST/2200 GMT Friday, November 15.
Schnitzer is offering $7.50 a share for all outstanding Proler stock. The two have signed a definitive merger pact.
Schnitzer's tender offer had been set to expire today. The new period for withdrawal rights ends November 15.
Before the tender offer began on September 20, Proler had about 4.7 million shares outstanding.
